title: Dependency contract kernel
description: Objective: model immutable typed dependency contracts, witnesses, stability, horizons, alternatives, and challenge results. Deliverable: focused scheduler dependency modules and property tests. NOT in scope: scheduling, materialization, expansion, or semantic auto-merge. Hard dependencies: Runtime contract registry and Planning graph lifecycle core from M1. Owned paths: packages/scheduler/src/dependencies/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test.
definitionOfDone: Blocking edges require a complete typed contract and exact witness provenance.
MONOTONIC is schema-proven; uncertainty defaults REVOCABLE and invalidation is explicit.
Redundant-edge conclusions remain candidates requiring semantic proof.
taskRails: Graph Beta cannot activate until the proven Foundation runner contracts it consumes are green.
A dependency, readiness, fairness, or semantic claim without daemon-verifiable evidence is UNKNOWN or refused.
Keep tasks file-disjoint where possible; order is a presentation hint, not a fabricated hard dependency.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400; explicit paths only and no sibling worktree.
